posts.text: Alaska prosecutors have been trying to seize this guy's plane for 13 years now. State courts have held that seizing a $95,000 plane over a forbidden six-pack of beer does not violate the 8th Amendment's prohibition against excessive fines. Now SCOTUS will take a crack at it. Kind of a crazy case.

posts.text:
Lots of important stuff, but these two stood out from the analysis:

1) Americans are not helpless.

2) No ideology or authoritarian state is self-executing. You facilitate it by insisting you have no choice and you halt it by refusing to lend it the legitimacy and weight of your participation.
posts.summary: Citizens can resist authoritarianism through refusal and non-participation
